title: Three-index coherence of normalized semilinear scalar tensor comparison
statement: Let J be a small ringed site, B_n a sequence of commutative ring sheaves with adjacent maps tau, and A the ordinary semilinear derived calculus [def-coef-semilinear-derived-calculus]. For every s >= m >= n and K,L in D(B_s), scalar extension to n of the scalar/tensor comparison for s to m, followed by the scalar/tensor comparison for m to n and tensor of the two specified scalar associators, equals the scalar associator applied to the level-s tensor followed by the scalar/tensor comparison for s to n. All maps are exactly those of A, for arbitrary ring maps and including equal indices.

source.place: (2), transposes of the units and counits, tensor associativity, and evaluation to finite maps

proof.text: Derived evaluation at s has a left adjoint F: transport the normalized derived singleton extension across the strict-system/sequence-site equivalence and the canonical identity-on-sections evaluation identification. For inputs K,L put P=F(K), Q=F(L), R=P tensor Q and let u: K tensor L -> e_s(R) be tensor of the two adjunction units followed by inverse tensorEvaluation_s.

For an index map a from s to t, put p_a=scalar_a(unit_K) followed by reduction_a(P), and similarly q_a. The singleton evaluation mate theorem makes p_a and q_a invertible. Tensor/reduction compatibility and naturality of scalarTensor give scalar_a(u) followed by reduction_a(R) and tensorEvaluation_t = scalarTensor_a(K,L) followed by tensor(p_a,q_a). This is proved directly by canceling tensorEvaluation_s and applying tensor_reduction_formula.

Postcompose the desired equality with tensor(p_(h trans k),q_(h trans k)), an isomorphism. Naturality of scalarComposition and the reduction cocycle replace scalarComposition_K followed by p_(h trans k) with scalar_h(p_k) followed by reduction_h(P), and likewise for Q. Naturality of scalarTensor_h moves tensor(scalar_h(p_k),scalar_h(q_k)) across that comparison. Apply the previous tensor/reduction equality for k, then tensor_reduction_formula for h on P,Q. The reduction cocycle on R and naturality of scalarComposition at u identify this composite with scalarComposition_(K tensor L) followed by scalar_(h trans k)(u), reduction_(h trans k)(R), and tensorEvaluation_n. Apply the previous equality for h trans k, then cancel tensor(p_(h trans k),q_(h trans k)). This argument works for equal indices and arbitrary coefficient maps.

proof_origin.place: Paragraph (2): derive scalar/tensor associativity from the already established tensor/reduction compatibility and the actual reduction cocycle, using invertible singleton evaluation mates; no new representative-coherence assumption.

theorem scalarTensor_composition (A : Data.{c, v, r} J B τ)
    {s m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) (k : m ≤ s)
    (K L : D.{c, v, max c v r} J (B s)) :
    (A.scalar h).T.map ((A.scalarTensor k).hom.app (K, L)) ≫
        (A.scalarTensor h).hom.app ((A.scalar k).T.obj K, (A.scalar k).T.obj L) ≫
        (A.levelClosed n).tensor.map
          (Prod.mkHom ((A.scalarComposition h k).hom.app K)
            ((A.scalarComposition h k).hom.app L)) =
      (A.scalarComposition h k).hom.app ((A.levelClosed s).tensor.obj (K, L)) ≫
        (A.scalarTensor (h.trans k)).hom.app (K, L)
